one_liner: OptimalPSI develops patient-specific spinal implants. ETH Zurich spin-off recognition and a 2025 Venture Kick award make it worth meeting now.

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich recognizes OptimalPSI as a spin-off.
OptimalPSI won CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick in 2025 and secured an Innosuisse grant in 2024.

Model score 92.1 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Spin-off status, the deep-tech classification, technical founders, an ETH Zurich doctorate and a six-founder flag pushed the score up. The records list three co-founders and three clinical advisors, so the six-founder flag is unconfirmed.
